name: phishing_check
description: Flag messages that are phishing or scam attempts

question.instructions: Is this message a phishing or scam attempt?

criteria.true: The message tries to trick the reader into giving up credentials, money, personal data, or into clicking or installing something malicious.
criteria.false: The message is legitimate, even if it is marketing, a notification or asks the reader to take an ordinary action.
